I've treated the two roads with fast-running floodwater and a swept-away truck as unusable. Car1 stays at Panchakanya because its only remaining road leads to Suryagadhi school, which is not an evacuation point. The Tarkeshwar group is also unreachable, since the only road from there is washed out. Those five people are deferred, as are the Naukunda shopkeepers and the Shivapuri farmer, because rescuing them costs more driving than the penalty saved. The four Jwalamukhi adults are deferred for the same reason.
